adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: In 2012, Brock Rumlow's STRIKE team carries Loki's scepter out of Stark Tower for Alexander Pierce, headed for HYDRA's Dr. List.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Pierce's STRIKE leader, who carries off Loki's scepter for him in 2012.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The HYDRA boss Rumlow carries Loki's scepter away for in 2012.
adds.evidence: Endgame, 2012 Stark Tower: Rumlow and STRIKE, secretly ordered by Pierce, take the scepter to deliver to List; Sitwell reports to Pierce from the elevator with Rumlow present.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: In 2012, Jack Rollins rides out of Stark Tower with the STRIKE team carrying Loki's scepter to HYDRA for Alexander Pierce.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A STRIKE agent carrying Loki's scepter to HYDRA for Pierce in 2012.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The HYDRA boss Rollins's team carries Loki's scepter for in 2012.
adds.evidence: Endgame, 2012: Rollins accompanies Sitwell and Rumlow taking the scepter to List on Pierce's orders (no direct exchange between the two on screen).

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: In 2012, Jasper Sitwell takes Loki's scepter out of Stark Tower and calls Alexander Pierce from the elevator to report it secure and on its way to Dr. List.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Calls Pierce in 2012 to report Loki's scepter secure.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The boss Sitwell reports to about Loki's scepter in 2012.
adds.evidence: Endgame, 2012 Stark Tower elevator: Sitwell to Pierce, 'Evidence secure. We're en route to Dr. List. No hitches at all, Mr. Secretary.'

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: In 2012, Jack Rollins rides the Stark Tower elevator with Brock Rumlow's STRIKE team as they carry Loki's scepter to HYDRA, until Steve Rogers fools them into handing it over.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Rides with Rumlow's team carrying Loki's scepter in 2012.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Leads the STRIKE team Rollins carries Loki's scepter with in 2012.
adds.evidence: Endgame, 2012: Rollins accompanies Rumlow and Sitwell taking the scepter down the elevator; Steve retrieves the Mind Stone from these Hydra sleeper agents.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: In 2012, Natasha hands Loki's scepter to Rumlow's STRIKE team and warns him to be careful with it. He promises they will, then takes it to HYDRA.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Hands Rumlow Loki's scepter in 2012 with a warning.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Takes Loki's scepter from Natasha in 2012 and carries it to HYDRA.
adds.evidence: Endgame, 2012 Stark Tower: Natasha ('Careful with that thing') and Clint warn STRIKE; Rumlow answers 'We promise to be careful', then takes it to List for Hydra.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Bruce and Rocket find a broken, drinking Thor in New Asgard and talk him into joining the plan to undo the Snap.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Bruce finds broken in New Asgard and brings back.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who comes to New Asgard to bring Thor back.
adds.evidence: Endgame: Banner and Rocket travel to Norway, visit New Asgard and recruit an overweight, despondent Thor.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Valkyrie greets Bruce and Rocket at New Asgard, says she liked Bruce better either of his two ways, and points them to Thor.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Greets Bruce in New Asgard and points him to Thor.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Comes to New Asgard for Thor. Valkyrie points him there.
adds.evidence: Endgame, New Asgard docks: Valkyrie meets Banner and Rocket, says she preferred him either of his two ways, warns Thor won't see them, directs them to his house.

owner_calls.title: Avengers: Endgame
owner_calls.question: In 2012 at Stark Tower, Bruce bursts into the lobby, Tony drops the Tesseract and Loki grabs it and escapes. They never exchange anything, but Bruce's entrance causes the escape of this very Loki. Add an Endgame stage?
options: add enemy stage: Bruce's crash into the lobby sends the Tesseract to Loki, who escapes with it
owner_calls.evidence: Endgame: Hulk burst into the lobby from the stairwell, causing Stark to drop the Tesseract; Loki retrieved it and escaped.
